name: decisionlint-le
description: Lint the questions you send to TypeSafe's Jev model and OpenAI's Decisions API (gpt-6-luna) as you type, with no API key and no network calls. An optional command asks Jev or Luna itself to check a file

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Linting works everywhere. Checking a file with Jev sends its questions to TypeSafe and is disabled in an untrusted workspace.

decisionlint-le.rules.markdownDescription: Severity per rule, by code or name. Values: `off`, `hint`, `info`, `warning`, `error`. A rule not listed keeps its default. An entry that names no rule or no level stops linting and says why, as it would in a `decisionlint-le.json`. Example: `{ "JEV004": "off" }`.

decisionlint-le.fallbackOptions.markdownDescription: Words that make a Choice option a fallback for `JEV004`. An option counts when one of these is a word in its name, matched case-insensitively with `_` and `-` read as spaces, so `none_implied` counts under `none`.

decisionlint-le.ignore.markdownDescription: Findings to drop, as `CODE:questionId`. Example: `JEV004:department`. This is the way to suppress a finding in JSON, which has no comments.

decisionlint-le.target.markdownDescription: The platform this project sends every request to, which sets the limits the rules check: `litellm` holds a request to 128 questions, `openai` publishes none. Leave empty to read it from each request's model id, where the spelling says: `~typesafe/jev-latest` is OpenRouter, `typesafe-ai/jev` is Vercel. A `decisionlint-le.json` with a `target` replaces this.

decisionlint-le.include.markdownDescription: Glob of files the workspace command lints.

decisionlint-le.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob of files the workspace command skips.

decisionlint-le.maxFileSizeBytes.markdownDescription: Files larger than this are reported as skipped, not linted.

decisionlint-le.ask.models.markdownDescription: The model id each Ask command sends, by platform: `typesafe` for **Ask Jev**, `openai` for **Ask Luna**, `openrouter`, `vercel`, `llmgateway` and `liquid` for the others, each in that platform's own spelling. The TypeSafe default is the version the checks were calibrated on, and a finding from any other model says where its cutoff was set. An alias such as `jev-latest` will move those cutoffs under you.

decisionlint-le.ask.keys.markdownDescription: An API key per platform, by the same ids, and `endpoint` for a host you name. User settings only, never a workspace's, so a key cannot end up in a repository, and left out of Settings Sync. The **Set ... API Key** commands store a key in the system keychain instead, which keeps it out of a plain-text file. A key typed here is used ahead of one in the keychain, and both ahead of the platform's own environment variable.

decisionlint-le.ask.endpoint.markdownDescription: The full URL **Ask the Model at My Endpoint** posts to: a platform you host, such as llama.cpp, vLLM, LiteLLM or Ollaya, or a gateway reached by a model spelling the other commands do not cover. User settings only, never a workspace's, so a repository cannot point your key at a host of its choosing. A host this tool does not know is sent the `endpoint` key, else the key in `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`, whichever the shape's SDK reads, or no key when none is set.

decisionlint-le.ask.endpointShape.markdownDescription: The request shape sent to `decisionlint-le.ask.endpoint` where its path does not end in `/systemone` or `/decisions`: `typesafe` for a System One body, `openai` for a Decisions body. Leave empty otherwise.

decisionlint-le.ask.endpointModel.markdownDescription: The model id sent to `decisionlint-le.ask.endpoint`. A llama.cpp with one model loaded ignores it; a proxy routes by it.

decisionlint-le.ask.maxCalls.markdownDescription: The most requests one Ask command may send. Each question in the file costs one request. Questions past the limit are counted and not sent.

decisionlint-le.ask.sendState.markdownDescription: Also send the `state` written beside a `questions` map, so the model can check whether the state holds what each question asks about and whether it carries instructions. Off by default: with it off, only questions are sent. It applies only where the state is written out in the file.

decisionlint-le.ask.confirm.markdownDescription: Before an Ask command or the probe sends anything, show how many requests it will make, roughly what that costs and whether your state is sent, and wait for a yes. Off by default: running the command is taken as the decision to send.

enumDescriptions: Show every message, including the summary after each command.
Hide the summaries. Still say when a run was cancelled or files were left out.
Show a message only when a command you ran could not do anything.
decisionlint-le.notificationsLevel.markdownDescription: How much DecisionLint-LE tells you in notifications. Findings always appear in the editor and the Problems panel, whatever this is set to.
